name: Tests
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
jobs:
  lint:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 24
          cache: npm
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npm run lint
      - run: npm run typecheck # Builds first, as the framework typings are generated by tsup

  test:
    timeout-minutes: 60
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 24
          cache: npm
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npx playwright install --with-deps
      - run: npx playwright install msedge # The Microsoft Edge project uses the msedge channel, which the default install does not include
      - run: npx playwright test # Every project, so the framework harness suites (see test:frameworks) run too
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: failure()
        with:
          name: playwright-report
          path: playwright-report/
          retention-days: 14
